what_happened: Discovered via gh run view --log on all 3 failing docs.yml runs that leanprover-community/docgen-action's own internal 'Cache Mathlib docs' actions/cache step (post-if: success()) has NEVER saved, because the job always fails from OOM before reaching a success() state. This forces every run to cold-build the full ~6,300-target Mathlib+deps docInfo fan-out instead of restoring it, which is the dominant driver of the process-spawn ENOMEM -- a materially different and more actionable root cause than concurrency tuning (LEAN_NUM_THREADS) or swap size, both of which leave the fan-out count unchanged.

Reproduced GitHub Actions hashFiles('lake-manifest.json','references.bib') locally in python3 (sha256 over sorted files' sha256 digests) and got a123379d6db94f6a6c99fecd852af470f05772553661bc654a4c62dbce0f7b9d, byte-for-byte the cache key printed in run 44492038639's 'Cache not found for input keys' line. This turns the primary fix's largest risk -- saving under a key docgen-action never looks up -- into a locally verifiable pre-push check, removing a CI round-trip from verification.

The research report's generic derivation rule for the cache path list ('one path per lake-manifest.json package plus four implicit core modules') does not reproduce the verbatim list in the run log: the log carries Archive and Counterexamples (not manifest packages) and uses capitalized module-dir names (Mathlib, ImportGraph, ProofWidgets, Aesop, Batteries, Plausible) against the manifest's lowercase/camel names (mathlib, importGraph, proofwidgets, aesop, batteries, plausible). The plan therefore requires copying the log's verbatim 41-entry list rather than deriving it.

Re-ran the GitHub Actions hashFiles cache-key reproduction locally before writing the actions/cache/save step. First attempt (hex-string concatenation of the two files' sha256 digests) produced a non-matching key; correcting to raw sha256 DIGEST BYTES concatenation (not hex strings) reproduced the exact key a123379d6db94f6a6c99fecd852af470f05772553661bc654a4c62dbce0f7b9d observed in run 44492038639's log, confirming the cache-save step's key expression before any push.
